lines.text: On Thursday, the world's email simply stopped.
And on Friday, it was still stopped.
Microsoft's Outlook and Teams went down. Trouble was reported in 74 countries.
lines.say: Microsoft's Outlook and Teams went down. Trouble was reported in seventy-four countries.

lines.text: It was not a cyber attack, Microsoft said.
A large number of its servers had simply dropped out.
Picture four waiters. Two go home. The other two get every table.
And each time a server came back, the crowd flattened it again.
By Friday, Microsoft said things were slowly improving.
Until then, office workers faced something dreadful. Talking to each other.
